messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Paging: continuous-batching route 'generate-chat' experiencing sustained p99 > 8s and elevated 502s. Alert window: started ~11:04 UTC. Queue length in router > 1200, kv-cache shard sizes doubled in last 30m. Auto-escalate to oncall.

alex (oncall): ack — looking now. Marking incident, attaching to #inc-17753. Collecting runner metrics & config.

maria (eng-runtime): grabbing per-shard kv stats, seen prefix-tail growth on shard-7 and shard-2. Microbatch aggregation seems to be creating huge coalesced batches under high concurrency -> big queue + head-of-line blocking.

alex (oncall): logs snippet from rts on node-23:
```
[11:06:12] continuous-batch: queue_len=1342 microbatch_count=192 microbatch_size_tokens=204 total_kv_cache_bytes=1.9G
[11:06:19] handler: response_time=9053ms errors=42/120
[11:06:21] kvstore: evictions=0 write_amplification=3.1
```

sam (sre): seeing backpressure not triggering early enough; our batch window growth combined with sticky prefixes caused "cache thrash" where many requests renew prefixes and increase KV footprint. Suggest reduce max microbatch size and enable batch jitter.

maria (eng-runtime): agreed. Propose hotfix config: 
- set `continuous_batch.max_microbatch_tokens=64` (was 256)
- enable `continuous_batch.jitter_ms=[20,200]`
- lower `continuous_batch.backpressure_threshold=800`
- soft-evict old prefixes: reduce `kv.prefix_ttl` from 6h -> 10m temporarily

alex (oncall): preparing live patch. Will run canary 10% then scale if metrics look good. Notifying CS.

deploy-bot: rollout started: patch=cb-hotfix-1775345678 canary=10% -> 3 nodes.

alex (oncall): applying temporary cache eviction on shard-7 and shard-2 to stop immediate growth:
```
redwoodctl cache evict --shards=2,7 --prefix=tenant:* --age-gt=3600 --async
```

maria (eng-runtime): applied config via infra API:
```
redwoodctl config set continuous_batch.max_microbatch_tokens=64
redwoodctl config set continuous_batch.jitter_ms=20,200
redwoodctl config set continuous_batch.backpressure_threshold=800
redwoodctl config set kv.prefix_ttl=600
```

deploy-bot: canary patch rolled to 3 nodes at 11:18 UTC. Health checks running.

sam (sre): initial telemetry: p99 dropping from ~9s -> ~2.8s on canary nodes, error rate down 70%. Queue length on canary nodes fell to ~300.

alex (oncall): flushing caches on remaining hot nodes to prevent re-infestation:
```
redwoodctl cache flush --scope=continuous-batch --shards=all --grace=30s
```

maria (eng-runtime): after global flush + canary success, p99 stabilized ~1.2s cluster-wide, errors returned to baseline. Observed residual tail for a particular tenant (tenant:enterprise-42) — investigating spike pattern.

tara (customer-success): notified affected customers and opened ticket CS-12345 for enterprise-42. They reported degraded UX between 11:03–11:25 UTC. I've queued update to customers: "mitigation applied, continued monitoring, RCA pending."

alex (oncall): good. Creating short runbook note and will hand off to @eli for overnight watch. Key items to pass on:
- what changed: max_microbatch_tokens 256->64, jitter enabled, backpressure threshold lowered, prefix_ttl 6h->10m (temp)
- commands to revert: `redwoodctl config set continuous_batch.max_microbatch_tokens=256` etc.
- cache ops history: evict + flush commands run.
- metrics to watch: continuous-batch.queue_len, p99_latency, kv_cache_bytes_per_shard, tenant_error_percent

eli (oncall-next): ack — will monitor dashboards and watch for re-growth. If queue_len > 900 or p99 > 3s for >5m, escalate to eng-runtime oncall.

maria (eng-runtime): quick note — root cause hypothesis: high-concurrency steady-state combined with a hot tenant prefix pattern caused batch coalescing to produce very large microbatches; those microbatches increased KV working set and prevented timely evictions. Need follow-ups: smarter per-tenant batching caps, adaptive jitter/backpressure, and telemetry for prefix churn.

alex (oncall): incident marked mitigated at 11:29 UTC. Leaving incident open for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Summary: config hotfix rolled (max_microbatch_tokens/jitter/backpressure and temporary TTL reduction) + cache flush/evict. Immediate customer impact limited and one enterprise ticket opened.

alex (oncall): filing postmortem draft and assigning RCA to maria (eng-runtime). Action items:
- short-term: add automatic circuit to limit microbatch growth per-tenant (owner: eng-runtime, ETA 3d)
- medium-term: improve kv eviction heuristics + telemetry (owner: eng-platform, ETA 2w)
- follow-up: revert prefix_ttl to previous after verifying eviction behavior (owner: oncall rotation)

maria (eng-runtime): will start RCA, capturing traces and sample prefixes for repro.

tara (customer-success): I'll update customers once the RCA outline is ready.

eli (oncall-next): noted. Taking over monitoring. Leaving this thread pinned in my sidebar.

alex (oncall): handing off formally to @eli. Handoff notes posted in #inc-17753 and runbook updated. If anything spikes overnight ping pager. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident timeline saved to /incidents/1775345678 and notifications sent to follow-up mailing list.

alex (oncall): closing real-time actions. Postmortem draft will be shared by EOD tomorrow.
